title: Add an explicit overridable default query scope
outcome: Agents receive lower-noise default results while retaining complete indexed evidence through an explicit all-content query.
acceptance: A host or repository can configure a documented default query scope without changing what Phoenix indexes.
An explicit all-content scope overrides the default and covers generated, vendored, and external indexed content.
Every coverage-bearing response echoes whether a default scope was applied and names it.
No index-time ignore rule is introduced, no existing limit is lowered, and the capability has its own features[] identifier plus a BuildInfo.Version bump.
